title: The Quiet Hymn
author: Noor Voss
blurb: Zephyrine Zhou, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
